title: MT3-C frozen parameters (written before any MT3-C result exists)

cost_model.form: C_hat(W) = a + b*W seconds; W = stable source words (whitespace split)
cost_model.fit_rule: OLS of per-sentence best-of-2 inference time (s) on source word count (whitespace split, as the scheduler counts stable words); all 520 dev sentences; best-of-repeats is MT-1's pre-declared steady-state latency estimator. Fit fixed before inspection; outlier-excluded fit is a diagnostic only.

parameters.finalization_convention_primary: F2: max(last stable-update time, sample audio end)
parameters.finalization_convention_continuity: F1: last stable-update time (frozen MT3-A/B convention)

rules.K_base: Reuses the frozen MT3-B K selection (evaluation/mt3_canonical/k_selection.json): candidate in {8,16,24} closest to the canonical-input median newly stabilized words per update (6). Input statistics only.
rules.K_max: Largest pre-registered MT3-B candidate (24); above the canonical-input p99 update size.
rules.T_max_s: Pre-declared system-design choice of about one typical update interval (canonical-input median gap between updates with new words, rounded up to 0.5 s). A design choice, not an optimum.
rules.T_max_sensitivity_s: Pre-declared robustness condition at the observed high-percentile update-gap scale (p95 gap, rounded). Reported only; never used to select T_max.
rules.W_R_s: Recent arrival-rate window covering about one high-percentile (p95) update interval.
rules.rho: Explicit system-design computation budget: approximate upper bound on the expected MT duty cycle used in the adaptive threshold (K >= R*C_hat/rho). Not derived from any MT3-C outcome. (The audit's input-derived 1 - ASR duty cycle = 0.565 was NOT adopted; 0.5 chosen as a round design budget.)
rules.cost_model: Linear in stable source words, fit on the AC re-benchmark of the 520-sentence MT-1 dev split only; the older MT-1 dev fit and all canonical MT3-A/B invocation timings are NOT used.

forbidden_inputs: MT3-A/B canonical delay, compute or invocation timings
measured MT runtime at decision time

cost_benchmark_environment.cpu_name: Snapdragon(R) X - X126100 - Qualcomm(R) Oryon(TM) CPU
cost_benchmark_environment.note: python_machine AMD64 on an ARM64 CPU means x64 emulation (Windows on ARM); all timings include emulation overhead.
